answer: The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in thread, expire in mirror, and saffron lists each expiry. An attacker running 83 aliases hence needs 135 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1006 identities would post 3132 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
